scenario.topic: Which e-reader should the book-loving couple standardize on

options.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite
options.upside: Offers waterproof design and adjustable warm light for comfortable reading.
options.concern: Limited support for EPUB format without conversion.

options.name: Kobo Clara HD
options.upside: Supports EPUB natively and has ComfortLight PRO for eye protection.
options.concern: Smaller storage capacity compared to some competitors.

options.name: Barnes & Noble Nook GlowLight 4
options.upside: Includes physical page-turn buttons and adjustable color temperature lighting.
options.concern: Limited ecosystem for purchasing books compared to larger platforms.

options.name: PocketBook InkPad 3
options.upside: Large screen size and wide format support including DJVU and FB2.
options.concern: Battery life is shorter compared to some other models.

shared_context: A book-loving couple wants to standardize on one e-reader model for shared use. The device should support common e-book formats, have adjustable lighting, and offer a comfortable reading experience for extended periods.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a software engineer who enjoys reading during her daily commute and weekends.
personas.private_goal: To have a waterproof e-reader with long battery life and warm adjustable lighting for comfortable extended reading.

A.reason_for: Waterproof design and adjustable warm light make it ideal for comfortable reading anywhere, plus long battery life.

B.reason_for: Supports EPUB natively and has eye-friendly lighting.
B.reason_against: Smaller storage and shorter battery life than preferred; no waterproofing.

C.reason_for: Adjustable color temperature lighting and physical page-turn buttons add comfort.
C.reason_against: Smaller storage and limited book ecosystem compared to larger platforms.

D.reason_for: Large screen and wide format support are appealing features.
D.reason_against: Shorter battery life and no waterproofing make it less ideal for Maya's needs.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a literature professor who values format flexibility and eye comfort for long reading sessions.
personas.private_goal: To have an e-reader that supports EPUB natively with eye protection features and decent storage.

A.reason_for: Long battery life and waterproofing are good, but limited EPUB support is a major downside.
A.reason_against: Requires format conversion for EPUB, which disrupts reading flow.

B.reason_for: Native EPUB support and ComfortLight PRO provide the best reading experience for Liam's preferences.

C.reason_for: Supports EPUB and has adjustable lighting with physical buttons for ease of use.
C.reason_against: Limited ecosystem and smaller storage are drawbacks.

D.reason_for: Wide format support including EPUB and large screen are positives.
D.reason_against: Short battery life and no eye protection lighting reduce its appeal.
